privacy.html.title: Website privacy
privacy.html.body:
Website privacy

A plain-language outline of how this website is intended to operate.

Browsing the website

The proposed portfolio does not require visitor accounts, contact forms or direct payments. Optional advertising and analytics scripts are not planned. These intentions must be checked against the deployed website.

Hosting and external stores

The hosting provider may process request information, including IP addresses, browser information and timestamps, to deliver and protect the site. Actual provider practices and retention still require review. External storefronts have their own privacy practices.

Product privacy

Games and software need separate privacy notices based on the exact distributed version. No app privacy policy is activated by this draft.

Privacy requests

Publisher identity, contact, retention and applicable rights procedures remain pending. Do not send personal information through this preview.

Product support

Find the project and prepare useful information if you encounter a problem.

Find your product

Spudacus games

Sudoku · Word Search · Grid Hunt · Crossroads · Sector Rebound

Software and designs

Eden Comms · Eden Practical Designs

Installation and progress

Follow the release-specific instructions. Export progress where supported before updating. Do not uninstall or clear data to bypass an update-signature mismatch.

Preparing a report

Include product, version, distribution channel, device and OS, expected behavior and reproduction steps. Sanitize optional screenshots. Never include credentials, private messages, payment details or full backups.

Purchase and refund requests follow the relevant storefront process. Confidential security and privacy concerns require a verified private route. Support is not an emergency service.

Contact availability

No support contact or reporting service is activated by this preview. Contact details are pending verification and approval.
